jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Lab3 is a third\-party logistics (3PL) provider offering direct\-to\-consumer and wholesale fulfillment services from our New Jersey facility. We are a small, hands\-on team, and we are investing in AI tools to improve how we manage customer service, billing, and warehouse operations. **Position Summary** The AI Implementation Specialist will design, build, and maintain AI\-powered tools and workflows that automate manual processes across the business. This is a hands\-on building role. Approximately 80% of the time will be spent developing solutions within AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude, and approximately 20% coordinating with team members to roll those solutions out. The position reports to the CTO/COO. Initial projects include: * **Customer service request management.** Build a human\-in\-the\-loop system that captures incoming requests from email, WhatsApp, and phone, routes them to the appropriate team member, tracks follow\-up, and confirms resolution. * **Billing.** Automate invoice generation, invoice auditing, and billing status tracking. * **Later phases.** Service\-level (SLA) tracking and warehouse operations processes. **Responsibilities** * Identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone processes and propose practical AI\-based solutions * Design, build, test, and maintain automations, agents, scheduled tasks, and workflows within AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, and similar tools) * Evaluate and integrate complementary automation tools (for example, Zapier or Make) where appropriate * Take ownership of assigned problems from initial discussion through delivery, including testing and iteration based on feedback * Document workflows and tools so that team members can use and maintain them * Communicate progress, options, and trade\-offs clearly to leadership and end users **Qualifications** * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building solutions with AI platforms such as ChatGPT or Claude, including agents, custom GPTs or projects, scheduled tasks, or automated workflows * Ability to take a loosely defined business problem and deliver a working solution with minimal supervision * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects at once * Clear written and verbal communication skills * An understanding of business processes and how to improve them * Comfort working with systems and data; programming experience is not required Early\-career candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you have built AI tools, agents, or automations on your own, including personal projects is a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** * Annual salary: $80,000 (full\-time, exempt) * Paid time off * Standard business hours; no travel required **Work Location and Schedule** This is a hybrid position. Our office is currently located in Ridgefield, NJ, and will be relocating to the Edison/Somerset area. The role is primarily on\-site, with one to two remote days per week. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of northern or central New Jersey. **Hiring Process** Apply using the link below. Selected candidates will have a short screening conversation, followed by two to three interviews with the team. The target start date is mid\-October 2026\. **How to Apply** Apply at: https://app.heedhire.com/apply/intk\_3a303547\-8685\-4f76\-89c6\-4ac5b288d142 **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lab3 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Pay: $80,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Database Engineer, AWS Data Platforms
jobs.description: Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution. **Your first assignment** In your first assignment, you will own the queries, stored procedures, views, and logical data models for your assigned part of a federal agency's enterprise data platform. You will build and maintain these components in Amazon Aurora and the platform stores alongside it, taking responsibility for their accuracy and performance. You will make database\-design decisions within the established platform architecture and carry your work through implementation and ongoing maintenance. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here. We hire people, not seats, and move our best to where the hardest problems are. **What you'll build** * Reliable Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) that work with DynamoDB, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Apache Iceberg tables and turn raw data into something people can use. * Logical data models and database schemas for your assigned components, designed to keep the relational and platform stores working together within the established platform architecture. * Tuned queries, S3 data loads into the platform stores, and connectivity, all under governed access. * And over time, the firm itself, through the new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help launch. **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, with version control and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making physical\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. **What you'll need** Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, including the years, certifications, and specific tools, we ask in the application and discuss during the interview. **What we offer** A high\-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real\-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands\-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles.* **Requirements** * At least four years of database development experience * Bachelor's degree * SQL on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), working with DynamoDB, S3, and Apache Iceberg tables * Stored procedures, views, and query tuning * Data loading from S3 into the platform stores, plus Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Physical\-design ownership of Aurora and Iceberg stores, or the drive to grow into it * Access governed by Apache Ranger * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Noble Machines** ======================== Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission\-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real\-world problems, we'd love to talk. **About the Role** ================== Noble Machines is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to be the critical link between our robotics platform and the customers putting it to work in the field—construction sites, mines, and energy facilities where the work is hardest and the stakes are highest. You'll deploy, integrate, and support our robots on\-site, troubleshoot issues that span software, hardware, and networking in real time, and feed what you learn in the field directly back into product and engineering. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who is just as comfortable configuring a system as they are climbing onto equipment or debugging from a jobsite trailer. **What You'll Do** ================== * Lead on\-site deployment, installation, and integration of Noble Machines' robots at customer sites across construction, mining, and energy * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers during deployment, resolving hardware, software, autonomy, and networking issues in real time under field conditions * Partner with engineering, autonomy, and hardware teams to translate field learnings, edge cases, and customer feedback into concrete product requirements and improvements * Design and refine scalable deployment processes, tooling, and documentation as Noble Machines' customer base grows * Own technical outcomes end\-to\-end—from pre\-deployment planning and site readiness through go\-live, training, and ongoing support * Provide hands\-on training to customer operators and site personnel on safe, effective robot operation * Conduct root\-cause analysis on field incidents and drive fixes across hardware, firmware, and software * Travel regularly to customer sites, including remote and industrial environments, to support deployments and maintain uptime **What You'll Bring** ===================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years of experience solving problems at the intersection of hardware, software, and networking, ideally in unstructured or field environments * Proficiency in Python and/or C\+\+, with the ability to read, debug, and modify code across the stack * Comfort working hands\-on with physical systems—wiring, sensors, mechanical troubleshooting—in addition to software * Strong ownership mentality and the ability to work independently on ambiguous, high\-stakes problems with shifting requirements * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build trust with customers in high\-pressure field environments * Willingness to travel frequently to industrial and remote job sites, including construction sites, mines, and energy facilities * Ability to perform physical tasks associated with fieldwork (e.g., lifting equipment, working outdoors in utilities) * Familiarity with ROS/ROS2, autonomy stacks, or robot fleet management systems * Linux systems administration, networking, and on\-prem/edge deployment experience * Background in defense, automotive, or industrial robotics * Relevant safety certifications (OSHA 10/30, MSHA, or similar) **California Pay Transparency Statement** ----------------------------------------- Pay Transparency jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. Every customer we sign runs live workflows that have to keep working, and there are more of them every month. That's why we're hiring you. The Role This is an engineering role that lives where the product meets the customer. You'll stand up new customer workflows alongside our sales team, keep the live ones healthy, and own the systems that make both of those faster every month. Here's how we work, and it's the most important thing to understand about this job: **we do the work manually first, then we automate it.** When a workflow needs fixing, you fix it. Then you ask the real question, which is how to make that fix faster next time, or unnecessary, or something the customer can do for themselves. We expect you to keep scaling yourself, handling more and more by building systems behind you. The person who does well here is constitutionally incapable of doing the same manual thing twice without trying to automate it. You'll also own our QA product. An agent reviews production runs against each workflow's requirements and flags the ones that fall short. You'll review its verdicts, accept or reject what it files, and then make the agent better at its job. That loop is this role in miniature: do the judgment work yourself, then teach the system to do more of it. To be clear about what this isn't: it's not a support queue in the help desk sense, it's not a pre\-sales demo role, and it's not a consultant embedded at a customer site. You'll write and review real code every week, from our office, with the rest of the team. What You'll Do * Build out new customer workflows with the account executive who owns the account. They stay in the lead and bring you what the customer needs; you make it real. We want this as close to real time as possible, and making it faster is part of your job, not a nice\-to\-have * Support live customer workflows: fix what breaks, then remove the reason it broke * Own our QA product, from reviewing what the agent flags to making the agent sharper * Own how workflow changes get published: make sure deployments do what they're supposed to, catch the changes that shouldn't ship, and roll back cleanly when something is wrong * Watch for patterns. A workflow that keeps needing the same fix is telling you something upstream is wrong, and chasing that down is worth more than closing the ticket * Build the tooling, checks, and guardrails that make everything above take less time every month * Learn our customers' industry well enough to argue with how they describe their own process What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Real professional software engineering experience. You'll write and review production code every week, and defend the business logic you wrote. * Strong TypeScript, or strong experience in a comparable typed language plus the appetite to get to strong TypeScript quickly. * The ability to read unfamiliar code fast. Much of what you touch was written by someone else, or by an agent. * An instinct to automate your own work. This is the single most important trait for this role. Doing the manual version first is the job; leaving it manual is not. * Genuine interest in complicated real\-world processes. Prior authorization rules, billing codes, payer\-by\-payer exceptions that exist for reasons nobody ever wrote down. If a twenty\-step workflow that nobody has documented sounds tedious rather than interesting, this will be a frustrating job. * A customer\-centered instinct. The account executive owns the customer relationship and stays in the lead, so you won't be on every call. But every judgment call you make comes down to what this looks like to the person whose order it is. * Comfort in a company of four to six people, where the job is whatever it takes and you'll largely define your own benchmarks as you go. * Willingness to work in\-office five days a week, and to be around some evenings and weekends when something critical breaks. **Preferred:** * Forward deployed, solutions, implementation, or product engineering experience where you also wrote production code * Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, insurance, or another domain with dense rules you had to learn from scratch * Experience with durable workflow orchestration, browser automation, or long\-running job systems * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be We'll teach you the industry. We can't teach you to find it interesting. Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Forward Developed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your at You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process — just ask.* Iw9E8gJI5Z

jobs.title: Founding Enteprise Sales
jobs.description: **Build the pipeline and drive qualified opportunities that accelerate Hypercubic’s growth and revenue.** **About the role** ------------------ We’ve built an initial enterprise pipeline through founder\-led sales. Now we’re looking for an exceptional founding salesperson to dramatically expand that pipeline, keep opportunities moving, and help turn early traction into a repeatable sales motion. Your three core responsibilities: * Own the entire top of funnel: sourcing, prospecting, outreach, and qualification. * Drive opportunities from first call, owning demos, follow\-up, and deal progression. * Work with the CEO on strategy, pricing, negotiation, and closing. You’ll have meaningful ownership over who we pursue, how we reach them, and how we advance opportunities. You’ll build the playbook through daily execution and customer feedback, with room to take on more of the sales cycle as you grow. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **Create qualified pipeline.** Research accounts and generate opportunities through outbound, warm introductions, partners, conferences, and inbound leads. * **Run discovery.** Lead first calls, understand the problem and urgency, identify stakeholders, and establish whether there’s a credible path to a purchase. * **Keep deals moving.** Build champions, engage decision\-makers, identify blockers, and secure concrete next steps. * **Partner with the CEO.** Bring them into deeper demos, strategy, pricing, and negotiation with strong preparation. Own follow\-through afterward. * **Build the playbook.** Test messaging and channels, document what works, maintain an accurate pipeline, and use AI and automation to increase your output. Success means more qualified opportunities, faster deal progression, and more pilots converting into revenue. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * **Proven sales ability.** You’ve built your own pipeline and won complex enterprise business, ideally including six\- or seven\-figure contracts. You can point to deals you personally created and advanced. * **High agency.** You find ways into accounts and move independently without an established playbook. * **Enterprise judgment.** You build champions, navigate buying committees, and know when to push, adapt, or walk away. * **Technical curiosity.** You learn complex products quickly and earn credibility with engineers and executives. * **Sharp communication.** You write compelling outreach, run focused discovery, and get to the point. * **Disciplined execution.** You prepare thoroughly, keep an accurate pipeline, and follow through. * **Resourceful with tools.** You’re hands\-on with CRMs, prospecting tools, and AI. You build workflows that accelerate research, outreach, meeting preparation, and follow\-up. * **Ambition and coachability.** You take ownership of results, seek feedback, and want to become exceptional at your craft. You may be an AE who built your own pipeline, a standout BDR ready for broader ownership, or a founder who sold a technical product. You’re excited to be **Sales \#1**: own the playbook, learn directly from the founders, and shape the sales function as Hypercubic grows. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * A sustained increase in qualified enterprise opportunities. * More accounts progressing toward pilots and paid deployments. * Active deals with engaged stakeholders, understood blockers, and concrete next steps. * Repeatable sources of pipeline beyond the CEO’s personal network. * Driving the founders to spend more time in consequential bottom of the funnel customer conversations. * A repeatable sales playbook grounded in what actually wins business. You’ll help build the commercial foundation of a company tackling some of the world’s most consequential software. You’ll work closely with the founders and engineering team, influence how we reach the market, and see your work directly shape the business. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: This role is in\-person 5 days a week based in San Francisco, California near FiDi. * Sponsorship: Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor new H1B employment visas at this time. **Benefits** ------------ We offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Founding\-team level equity, * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K) * Monthly stipend to support your wellness and commute * Daily lunches/dinners and snacks in the office to fuel you * Generous PTO and sick day policy to rest and recharge **About Hypercubic** -------------------- At Hypercubic, we’re building AI systems that can understand, reason about, and rearchitect large\-scale legacy applications running on mainframes and COBOL. We work at the intersection of program analysis, knowledge extraction, and agentic systems, applied to some of the most critical enterprise software in the world. We’re a small, deeply technical team in San Francisco, backed by top investors, and working with some of the largest organizations in the world. Compensation Range: $100K \- $160K

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sylvan** ================ Sylvan is building autonomous revenue teams. We help B2B companies grow and protect revenue from their existing customers by identifying revenue\-driving signals and deploying agents that act on them at the exact moment, across every account. We work with customers ranging from fast\-growth startups to Fortune 500 enterprises like ServiceNow. Our ambition is to power the top\-line of the economy. We are guided by a core principle: no assholes, high mutual respect. We operate at high intensity, but with deep respect. Direct, honest, and no egos — just a shared obsession to win. We’ve raised $10M\+ from world\-class investors and strategics including TQ Ventures and HubSpot Ventures. We are a fully in\-office company based in New York City. **We will only hire A\-players and are highly willing to go above\-market in ownership, equity, and cash compensation.** We want world\-class builders who are excited by the opportunity to be part of a category\-defining company at the earliest stage. It won’t be easy. We’re going to move fast. But, it’ll be fun. **The Role** ============ You own a customer from initial data access through a working, trusted system: understanding their business objectives, constructing the context layer our agents run on, building and deploying the workflows, enhancing the agent harness as you learn what breaks, and then proving the whole thing delivers customer outcomes. The hardest part up front is the data. Every warehouse is a mess in its own way: tables nobody documented, three competing definitions of ARR, and a data team with an hour a week to give you. Until that resolves into something clean and usable, nothing built on top is trustworthy. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Understand what the customer’s business objectives. Sit with the customer's revenue and ops leaders, get to the goals behind the request, and decide what is worth building against. * Onboard new customers end to end. Scope data access, explore the warehouse with no documentation, and map a chaotic schema onto real business concepts. * Stand up the ontology and verify the mapping. Interview the customer's data team and business owners, resolve their own inconsistent definitions, and validate the mapping before anything gets built on top of it. * Build the signals and workflows on top of it. The predictions and actions the customer actually sees, and the agent harness behind them. When a step produces bad output for one customer, you diagnose it and improve it. * Own the value case. Agree the success measure with the customer up front, then build the case that we delivered against it: the analysis, the evidence, the technical substance behind a story we can point to. You’re honest when the number didn't move, and specific about why. * Make the next deployment faster. Validation frameworks, eval harnesses, reusable mapping tools — what you learn at one customer ships as tooling rather than tribal knowledge. **What You’ll Bring** ===================== * You work at the frontier of agent\-driven development. You've built your own setup rather than living on the defaults, and you keep finding ways to get more out of agents than they give most people. * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role (forward deployed, solutions, or software engineering with heavy customer exposure); former founders strongly encouraged * Deep data warehouse fluency. SQL, dbt, and real comfort in an undocumented five\-year\-old schema with nobody left to ask. * You can sit with a customer's data or ops team, extract what a business concept actually means to them, resolve the cases where their own people disagree, and encode it. * Applied data science literacy. Distributions, seasonality, validation design, calibration. You know when a result is noise. * Painstaking through to the artifact. You'll chase a broken join for three hours because a number looked slightly off, and you'll care as much about whether the customer can actually interpret the output. Correct data in an unreadable form isn't delivered. * You define success metrics rather than report on them, and you can build the case that the work delivered. You can also tell a customer their number didn't move and why. * You hold a technical position under pushback from a customer or from us, and change your mind for evidence rather than authority. * High tolerance for ambiguity and unglamorous work. Based in NYC, excited to be in\-office. **Equal Opportunity** ===================== Sylvan is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer, AWS Automation
jobs.description: Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution. Your first assignment In your first assignment, you will likely help build and operate the secure delivery pipelines that carry federal systems into production. The work may include: * Building and maintaining continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that take services from commit to deployment the same way every time, including progressive delivery through blue/green and canary deployments with automated health checks and rollback. * Writing infrastructure as code on Amazon Web Services (AWS) so environments come from templates rather than manual setup. * Containerizing services and keeping the images small, patched, and scanned. * Connecting monitoring, logging, and vulnerability scanning to make systems observable and provably secure. * Helping assemble the security evidence that carries a system through its Authority to Operate (ATO). What we offer A high\-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real\-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands\-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years. What we commit to As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles.* **Requirements** * At least one year of software development, platform, or operations engineering experience * A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field * Scripting ability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell * Working knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts, with hands\-on experience in at least one pipeline tool * Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud services and with containerization * Familiarity with infrastructure as code, using CloudFormation or Terraform * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Exposure to Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance, NIST SP 800\-53 controls, or Authority to Operate (ATO) processes * Experience with vulnerability scanning or security tooling (SAST, DAST, or policy\-as\-code) * Exposure to Amazon Web Services or an Amazon Web Services certification * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

Who you are You care about what you build and judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: **QA Automation Engineer II** **Department** Quality Assurance **Reports To** QA Manager **Location** Chicago, IL or Remote (US) **Role Overview** The QA Automation Engineer II plays a central role in strengthening automated test coverage and quality practices across our TMS. This is a heavy automation and AI role: you'll use AI daily as your default way of working, not as an occasional aid, paired with the judgment to validate what it produces rather than simply trust it. You'll also help establish AI\-assisted testing as a standard practice across the broader QA team, working alongside our QA Analysts as a peer. This is deliberately not a developer role, and it's not a fit for someone who assumes they already know better than the team and process they're joining. We're looking for someone who cares about getting this right, wants to learn our TMS and Salesforce platform well enough to have real opinions about both, and brings genuine curiosity and process discipline to the table. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the standing review function for automated test coverage across the TMS, an ongoing part of the job every time new coverage is added, not a one\-time audit. * Flag unreliable, flaky, or false\-positive tests, including AI\-generated tests, before they're trusted as real regression signal. * Maintain and extend automated test coverage for Revenova's Salesforce\-native TMS, working within the approach and priorities the QA Manager sets. * Use AI tools daily as the default way of working: generating test cases from a spec, maintaining and refactoring existing suites, and accelerating review of test output. * Build deep familiarity with the TMS and the underlying Salesforce platform. * Champion AI\-assisted testing as a required practice across the QA team, working directly alongside QA Analysts as the foundation for how that practice gets established and maintained, not as something offered only to whoever happens to be curious. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in real testing work is required, not a bonus. Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar. You can point to specific, concrete examples of how it changed your output, such as coverage reached faster or manual maintenance reduced. * The judgment to validate AI output, not just produce it. You can spot the failure mode where an AI\-generated test passes without asserting anything meaningful, or where AI\-assisted review misses a real defect. * 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java), within an AI\-assisted workflow. Not required to have built an automation framework from scratch. * Experience reviewing or auditing another engineer's or team's test automation code, including AI\-generated test code, with the judgment to explain whether it's good. * API and integration testing experience; able to identify which layer a given risk belongs to. * A QA mindset, not a developer's. Genuinely cares whether the product works for the people using it, not about proving they're the smartest person in the room. * Genuine curiosity about process and the product; wants to understand how our TMS and QA process work before suggesting changes. * Collaborative and coachable; comfortable being the most automation\-experienced person on the team without making that a whole identity. **Preferred Qualifications** * Salesforce platform experience, including automating against Lightning/LWC UI, Apex testing basics, and sandbox/scratch org lifecycle. * Logistics, TMS, freight brokerage, or supply chain software experience, including understanding load tendering, carrier management, rating, dispatch, and EDI/API carrier integrations. * Experience collaborating with a distributed or third\-party test automation team. * Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Administrator) are a plus.

jobs.title: Research Development Scientist/Engineer II
jobs.description: #### **Position Summary/ Objectives** The Research and Development Scientist/Engineer II is responsible for the design, development, and improvement of implantable regenerative medical devices from concept through commercialization. This role applies engineering and scientific principles to support product innovation while ensuring compliance with design control and quality system requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with hands\-on laboratory and product development experience and is capable of working independently to support both strategic and operational objectives. #### **Essential Job Functions:** * Independently contribute to the development of implantable regenerative medical devices in compliance with design control requirements. * Execute and document design control activities, including design inputs/outputs, risk management, verification, validation, and design transfer. * Design and conduct experiments, including feasibility studies, prototype fabrication, and characterization. * Analyze and interpret experimental and engineering data to support product development decisions. * Troubleshoot technical challenges across prototyping, process development, validation, and manufacturing scaleup. * Develop and maintain product specifications, test methods, and acceptance criteria. * Create and execute experimental protocols, technical reports, and documentation to support verification, validation, and regulatory submissions. * Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and external partners to ensure compliance and timely project execution. * Support R\&D equipment calibration and maintenance programs in accordance with quality system requirements. * Develop and revise SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation. * Maintain accurate and compliant design history file (DHF) documentation, including lab notebooks, protocols, and reports. * Ensure laboratory operations meet safety, organization, and inspectionreadiness standards. * Train and support R\&D personnel on procedures, equipment, and test methods. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through established quality and change control processes. * Participate in crossfunctional and special projects as needed. #### **Competencies:** 1\. Innovation and Scientific Curiosity 2\. Ownership and Accountability 3\. Execution and Efficiency 4\. Collaboration and Teamwork 5\. Integrity and Ethical Practice 6\. Resilience and adaptability #### **Education, Experience and Certification:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biological Sciences, Material Science or related field required. * Minimum of 3 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or minimum of 2 years with a Master’s degree, in medical device R\&D, preferably in regenerative or implantable technologies. * Experience with experimental design, material characterization, data analysis, and laboratory techniques. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities. * Strong analytical and problemsolving skills with a datadriven approach. * Effective collaborator with crossfunctional teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation * Experience with CAD software, prototyping tools or model software is a plus. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities. * Strong analytical and problemsolving skills with a datadriven approach. * Effective collaborator with crossfunctional teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. #### **Total Rewards \& Benefits:** #### **Regenity offers a comprehensive rewards package, including:** * Company performance bonus eligibility * 401(k) plan with company contribution * Paid time off and paid holidays * Medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance * Companypaid life and AD\&D insurance * Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Tuition Reimbursement Salary Range: $85,000\-$95,000 per year Regenity Biosciences, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. Regenity Biosciences celebrates the diversity of our team. We believe that talent, drive, and experience are the only relevant criteria for considering new team members. #### **About Regenity** Collagen Matrix is now Regenity Biosciences. Regenity Biosciences advances new frontiers in regenerative science, turning bioabsorbable materials into life\-changing solutions. Sought after for our novel resorbable technologies and distinct approach to contract manufacturing and contract development, our team brings the urgency and vision to deliver breakthrough medtech solutions for medical technology and medical device manufacturers of all sizes. For more than 25 years, Regenity Biosciences has been transforming bioabsorbable materials into regenerative solutions to repair and regenerate tissue and bone we have since introduced numerous bioresorbable technologies with more than 71 product lines commercially available worldwide. Most recently, Regenity expanded its product portfolio to include versatile bioresorbable polymer technologies via the acquisition of Polyganics, which was the impetus behind the new name and brand direction.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Site Leader
jobs.description: Description: JOB SUMMARY The Senior Operations Site Leader is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, compliance, and strategic execution of the manufacturing site. The Senior Operations Site Leader serves as the senior leader for the location and is accountable for achieving site goals related to safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, employee engagement, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement. This position partners closely with functional, corporate and commercial leaders to align site execution with business priorities, customer expectations, and long\-term operational strategy. Procurement and sourcing remain globally managed under the Global Supply Chain and Procurement Director. Strong leadership in a matrixed organization and across all levels of the business and all functions will be essential to drive the Treatt culture forward. DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES The duties and tasks of the Senior Operations Site Leader will involve the following: Site Leadership and Strategy * Lead the overall site strategy and execution plan to support business objectives, operational performance, customer requirements and growth priorities * Provide leadership and direction to site department heads, including Plant Management, Manufacturing, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering/Maintenance, Planning, Shipping and Warehousing, EHS and Continuous Improvement * Ensure strong alignment across functions so that site priorities are clear, resources are effectively deployed and decisions support safety, quality, service and cost objectives * Serve as the senior site representative and primary point of accountability for site performance, culture, communication and execution * Drive standardization of business processes across the site, aligned with the wider Döhler Group * Support the SAP roll\-out for the site, driving readiness and adoption across all site functions * Lead effectively within a matrixed organization to execute on milestones and move Treatt North America forward to increased success Operational Performance * Oversee site operations to ensure achievement of production, service, quality, safety, cost and productivity goals * Partner with the Plant Manager and operational leaders to identify performance gaps, resolve issues and implement sustainable improvements * Monitor key performance indicators and use data to drive decision\-making and accountability, taking counter actions to bring performance back on track * Ensure effective planning and execution of production schedules, capacity planning, labor utilization, material flow and operational readiness Engineering, Maintenance and Asset Reliability * Provide leadership and direction to Engineering and Maintenance, ensuring asset reliability, equipment uptime, preventive maintenance and technical support meet site performance requirements * Own the site capital plan end to end, from identifying and justifying investment through approval, execution and post\-implementation review, ensuring projects deliver the expected operational and financial return * Apply sound technical and engineering judgment to process improvement, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, automation and the introduction of new equipment or processes * Ensure engineering standards, process safety requirements and management of change are applied consistently to all site projects, modifications and new installations * Balance short\-term production demands against long\-term asset health, ensuring maintenance and reliability are not deferred in ways that create future risk Safety, Health and Environment * Drive a continuously improving, safety\-first culture so all our employees go home safely every day, with accountability for the HSE performance of the site * Hold leaders accountable for safe work practices, risk reduction, incident prevention and timely corrective action * Partner with EHS leadership to strengthen programs, improve safety performance and build employee ownership of safety expectations Quality, Regulatory and Compliance * Ensure the site operates in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, customer standards, company policies, food safety requirements, quality systems and audit expectations * Support a strong quality and compliance culture, ensuring that production goals do not compromise product quality, regulatory obligations or customer trust * Partner with Quality and Regulatory leaders to maintain inspection readiness, address audit findings and drive corrective and preventive actions * Ensure work is performed in accordance with appropriate Standard Operating Procedures, policies and practices Planning and Warehousing * Lead site planning, shipping and warehousing to ensure effective scheduling, inventory manag ing, with a ‘fail fast, learn fast’ mentality * Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, employee relations, training and change management * Communicate clearly and consistently with employees at all levels to reinforce priorities, expectations, progress and business context * Act in the best interests of the Treatt Group at all times Success Measures * Safety performance and risk reduction * Quality and regulatory compliance * Delivery performance, including OTIF and schedule attainment * Cost, productivity and budget performance * Employee engagement and leadership capability * Continuous improvement results, audit performance and inspection readiness Requirements: EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Process or Industrial) or a related technical field required, reflecting the process manufacturing environment. MBA or advanced degree preferred * Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations management experience in flavors, food ingredients or closely related regulated manufacturing environments * Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers or cross\-functional teams * Demonstrated experience leading site operations, plant performance, safety, quality, service, cost and continuous improvement initiatives * Experience managing budgets, capital projects, cost improvement initiatives and operational performance metrics * Technical or engineering grounding in a process manufacturing environment, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and technical specialists on equipment, process design, reliability and capital investment decisions * Experience overseeing an engineering or maintenance function, including preventive maintenance programs, asset reliability and plant capital planning * Experience working in a global organization or matrixed reporting environment preferred * GMP, Six Sigma and 5S implementation expertise required; formal Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred * Advanced SAP or (ERP) user; experience contributing to or leading SAP or (ERP) rollouts strongly preferred SKILLS \& ABILITIES * Can do attitude, focused on delivery not title * Strong organizational skills, with the ability to plan and deliver multiple projects to clearly defined deadlines * Entrepreneurial vision – a self\-starter with a hands\-on approach * Ability to lead and influence a culturally diverse team * Strong operational focus and strategic vision to see the wider picture * Great interpersonal and relationship skills with the ability to lead, manage, motivate and influence teams and colleagues * Solid working knowledge of budgeting, operations, supply chain and strategic planning * Excellent understanding of financial data * Strong planning skills across production scheduling, capacity and materials management * Highly analytical, with strong communication skills to translate data into clear priorities and actions * Strong understanding of regulated manufacturing environments, quality systems, food safety and GMP requirements, EHS expectations and operational controls * Technical fluency in process manufacturing, with the ability to interpret process and reliability data, understand the unit operations and equipment that drive site performance and constructively challenge engineering and maintenance decisions * Strong problem\-solving and change management skills * Capable of difficult decision making – utilizing all the appropriate information required, and sharing views with key stakeholders WORKING CONDITIONS * Environment: Fully on\-site leadership role based at the Lakeland facility, with no home office arrangement. Office, lab and manufacturing environment, including shop floor exposure inside and outside production areas; potential exposure to hazardous chemicals * Physical Factors: Sitting, walking, standing * Travel: Occasional domestic travel with periodic overseas travel to the UK.

We’re obsessed with finding better ways to solve tough problems, and we know the next big idea can come from anyone, including you. If you’re a self\-starter, a natural leader, and someone who truly cares about the work you do, you’ll fit right in at Gravitate. #### **About the Role:** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Software Engineer (Entry Level) to join our growing technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their career who is passionate about building software solutions that solve real\-world problems. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and maintain our suite of applications across a variety of platforms. #### **Responsibilities:** * Own well\-defined tasks within your team’s product area, working closely with senior engineers on larger projects. * Deliver reliably against sprint commitments; flag risks as soon as you see them. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation while building a working understanding of monitoring and observability. * Participate in code reviews, taking direct feedback and acting on it while contributing to team knowledge sharing. * Develop working knowledge of the fuel supply and logistics industry as it applies to your team’s product area. * Follow the team’s established design patterns and conventions, and be able to explain design decisions in review. * Write clean, tested code, taking ownership of the implementation, automated testing, and validation over the quality of your work. * Communicate early and often, focusing on learning and providing feedback to your team. #### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Internship, co\-op or professional experience in a software development organization * Solid understanding of software development fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures. * Familiarity with web development technologies, APIs, databases, and version control systems like Git. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages; **preference given to candidates with experience in our stack (Python, .NET (C\#), Typescript, React)**. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. #### **Nice to Have (but not required):** * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience with CI/CD systems like Github Actions. * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. #### **Why Join Us?** At Gravitate, people are not replaceable parts—they are the heart of our success. We believe in open communication, teamwork, and clapping for each other at every opportunity. Our culture emphasizes growth, collaboration, and creating lasting careers. Problem solvers, go\-getters, and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.description: **AI Software Engineer \- Agentic AI for Semiconductor Manufacturing** **Location:** Menlo Park, CA **Type:** Paid Internship, with possibility to extend contract once performance proven **Reports to:** CEO and Global Sales \& Marketing Director About SemiAI SemiAI builds AI software for semiconductor manufacturing. Our platform helps fabs improve yield, predict process issues, and accelerate root\-cause analysis. We are building a lean U.S. hub in Menlo Park to support global semiconductor customers and develop young AI/software talent. Role Overview * Build agents and LLM\-powered tools — tool calling, retrieval, planning loops, structured outputs * Design the evaluations that tell you whether the system actually works, not just whether it ran * Explore and clean real customer data: undocumented columns, missing values, sensor noise * Build and test models on process data — and be honest about what the numbers mean * Turn prototypes into things your teammates can run, with documentation that holds up * Present a weekly demo: what you built, what broke, what you learned Qualifications * Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Physics or a related field * Strong Python — comfortable with pandas and NumPy, and comfortable reading code you didn't write * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs: API calls, prompting, tool use, retrieval, or agent loops. Personal projects count fully. * Solid ML fundamentals — train/validation/test discipline, evaluation metrics, and an instinct for when a result looks too good to be true * Fluent with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, and thoughtful about where you trust them and where you don't * Real curiosity about a physical, industrial domain you've never worked in * Authorized to work in the United States Why SemiAI Semiconductor manufacturing is one of the few places where an AI agent has to actually be right. A bad prediction doesn't just look bad in a demo — it scraps wafers worth more than a car. That constraint makes the engineering harder and far more interesting. You'd be one of a small number of people in our U.S. hub, working directly with the CEO and our AI Engineers, on systems that go in front of real semiconductor customers. We built the U.S. team deliberately as a talent engine: we hand smart junior people real problems and grow the strongest into future AI and customer\-technology leaders. Pay: $20\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for an employment visa (e.g., H\-1B visa status)? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Menlo Park, CA 94025

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platforms
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Data Platforms is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software Engineer, Data Platforms assignments. * Grade cloud \& platform engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software Engineer, Data Platforms work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Cloud \& platform engineering * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer I
jobs.description: At Alaska Communications, we’re committed to putting our **team first**, always being **customer focused**, having a **can\-do attitude**, **owning our results** and always **acting with integrity**. This is what we hire for and what our team members exhibit each day. Want to make an impact with us? ***We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.*** The compensation range for this job is: * **POSITION SUMMARY** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of telecommunications infrastructure, including legacy TDM systems, modern VoIP/IP\-based networks, SS7 signaling, and E911 services. This role ensures reliable, secure, and high\-performance communication systems across the organization. The System Engineer will design, deploy, maintain and support telecom systems including TDM switches, (DMS 100, DMS 10, Redcom, Mitel), VoIP platforms (MetaSwitch), SS7 signaling systems for call routing, number portability, CLASS features, and implement and maintain E911 systems ensuring compliance with public safety regulations. As a member of a team that provides 24 x 7 x 365 operational infrastructure support, the Systems Engineer must be willing and capable of performing complex hands\-on network provisioning and management activities. This role demands solid technical grounding as well as excellent organizational skills and discipline to maintain focus effectively and efficiently while successfully managing multiple parallel projects and activities. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** ======================= **Reasonable Accommodations Statement** --------------------------------------- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Examples of Job Duties** -------------------------- * Install new hardware, systems, and software for network and system infrastructure. * Install, configure, and maintain network services, equipment, and devices for core and/or customer solutions. * Perform troubleshooting analysis of network and system infrastructure and associated systems. * Document network problems and their resolutions for future reference. * Support administration of servers and server clusters. Manage all system backups and restoration protocols. * Plan and support network and computing infrastructure. * Monitor system performance and implement performance tuning. * Manage user accounts, permissions, email, anti\-virus, anti\-spam. * Oversee software and network security. * Provide training instruction on platforms, equipment, and related applications. * Maintain network and call routing translations in TDM switches such as DMS\-100, DMS\-10, Redcom, and Mitel. * Maintain and support VoIP platforms, primarily MetaSwitch, to ensure reliable voice services. * Manage SS7 signaling systems for call routing, number portability, and CLASS feature delivery. * Implement and maintain E911 systems to ensure compliance with public safety. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Education Required** ---------------------- College diploma in the field of computer science, computer information systems, or computer engineering. Relevant experience could be substituted for the educational requirement on a year\-for\-year basis. **Experience Required** ----------------------- Up to 3 years of experience leading to the ability to work independently in the role. We hope you’ll join us as we change lives through technology.
