jobs.title: Associate Technician – GE 1.5
jobs.description: **Deutsche Windtechnik (DWT)** is Germany’s largest Independent Service Provider, offering a comprehensive service package for Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) from one single source. What makes us stand out from other service companies? We offer everything from A to Z and match that with a passion for all technical services related to wind power. The objective of our engineers and technicians is to individually increase efficiency and to keep availability high at all times. It is our objective to achieve the best possible technical operation for our client’s systems and in turn offer cost\-effective solutions. We do everything possible to keep the wind turbines up and running and improve their performance, for the long term. Deutsche Windtechnik is entering its fifth year of operations in the United States, and is headquartered in Houston, TX. As the largest and most reputable independent service provider in Germany, it is our objective to transfer and improve the same level of quality, safety, efficiency and customer service to the US market. Deutsche Windtechnik aims to become the strongest independent service provider in the US within the next 5 years, and you can be part of this success! **SCHEDULE****:** Typically, from 7am to 4:30pm, Monday through Friday, some weekends and shift work. Usually, 40 hours per week with 30 minutes/1 hour lunch break unless arrangements have been agreed to by the employer and the employee. 20\-25% travel required. **JOB SUMMARY**: This is a skilled position; Employees in this role perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems, understands schematics and uses appropriate diagnostic tools. The successful candidate will interpret fault reports, maintain power generation reports, service logs in the computer database, and monitor turbine performance. **ASSOCIATE TECHNICIAN SUMMARY** The technician should be able understand and utilize Deutsche Windtechnik documentation to include basic drawings and schematics, work procedures, equipment, tooling and machinery associated with routine wind turbine operation and maintenance. It expected that the technician will learn basic electrical and mechanical maintenance skills such that they will be able to perform maintenance related tasks independently, as well as provide adequate assistance to more experienced technicians in the performance of routine activities. **DEUTSCHE WINDTECHNIK CULTURE:** At Deutsche Windtechnik, what sets us apart is our intense focus on our customers, employees and culture. Our Mission is ***to be the most trusted O\&M partner******to wind farm owners,*** while Our Vision ***is to*** ***empower the Americas‘ achievement of 100% renewable energy, one wind turbine at a time.*** How do we accomplish this? By building a team and a culture with the core values that are Transparent, Innovative, Guiding (advisor and partner), Efficient (cost conscious) and Rapid (agile and bold). **MENTAL DEMANDS**: * Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals * Write routine reports and correspondence * Understand and follow customary instructions in order to perform the essential functions of the position in a satisfactory manner * Read and interpret blueprints and schematics * Deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations * Work with minimal supervision, given proper instructions **PHYSICAL DEMAND CLASSIFICATION**: * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. * The employee must be capable of lifting and/or moving up to 100 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. * Employee must be physically fit enough to free climb 250 ft multiple times a day while wearing 25\+ lbs. of climbing gear under extraordinary weather conditions. * Must be capable of rescuing team mate anywhere in tower in the event of emergency. Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions. **DESCRIPTION OF TASKS**: * The provision of preventative and corrective maintenance on GE 1\.5 wind turbines as per DWT instructions * Completion of all relevant paperwork, including work order cards, checklists, etc. * Ensure all health and safety procedures are followed * Performs scheduled maintenance as required * Performs unscheduled maintenance consisting of troubleshooting on mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems * Assist large corrective teams with replacement of major turbine components e.g. generators and gearboxes * Assist in all areas of site operations * Provide safe access and egress to all people in the work party * Establish and maintain general safety from the system/Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) * Comply with Deutsc  supervision, if needed) * Performs wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems troubleshooting and repairs * Recognizes occurrences of wind turbine error codes and appropriately reports the problem * Assists with removal and installation of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components * Assists with heavy equipment (crane) rigging and directing * Performs wind turbine controller maintenance and repair * Completes required reports and other paperwork, some of which require computer entry * Assists with high\-voltage system maintenance and repair * Maintains adherence to company policies, safety standards and good housekeeping practices * Maintains proper care of company tools and vehicles * Demonstrates the ability to learn advanced troubleshooting and repair of the wind turbines **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:** * High School Graduate/GED * Associate Degree preferred (not required) * Persons with Wind Energy Certifications, Military Experience, electrical and mechanical experience are highly encouraged to apply. * Experience 0 \+ 2 years in Wind Energy, electrical, mechanical and technical equipment * Valid driving license (NON CDL/CDL) * Must be able to pass a physical exam and drug/alcohol screening * Must be able to climb and work atop freestanding wind turbine towers that exceed 250 ft in height **EQUIPMENT, MACHINES, TOOLS USED:** Electrical Testing Equipment, Torque Wrench, Crane Rigging, Scada Systems, Computer, Computer Software, Scanner, Printer, Telephone, Copier, Fax Machine **DESCRIPTION OF WORK ENVIRONMENT:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; particulate matter and outside weather conditions. The employee can be exposed to risks of electrical hazards. The employee is occasionally exposed to hazardous chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:** This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position. Employee will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties requested by management. Management has the right to add to, revise, or delete information in this job description. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” employment relationship. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** Deutsche Windtechnik is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law. **EEO is the Law** Applicants and employees are protected under Federal law from discrimination. *Whenever employees are working, operating DWT supplied vehicles, on DWT premises, or are conducting DWT related work off\-site, they are prohibited from:* * *Using, possessing, buying, selling, manufacturing or dispensing an illegal drug (to include possession of drug paraphernalia);* * *Having alcohol or an illegal drug in their system; and* * *Possessing or consuming alcohol.* *Through UnitedHealthcare, UMR and HealthSCOPE Benefits creates and publishes the Machine\-Readable Files on behalf of Deutsche Windtechnik.* *To link to the Machine\-Readable Files, please click on the URL provided:* **https://transparency\-in\-coverage.uhc.com/** wQcy1qBMRD

jobs.title: Manager Systems Design Engineering
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Join a team that sits at the heart of product quality and customer satisfaction. Our Systems Design Engineering group ensures every product leaving our floor meets the highest standards of performance, safety, and reliability—because we know that what we build impacts real people every day. As a Systems Design Engineering Manager, you won’t just oversee the maintenance of our test systems—you’ll be a key player in safeguarding product integrity. You’ll work hands\-on with advanced test systems in our sensor manufacturing, troubleshoot challenges in real time, and directly influence how we validate and improve our products. Every day brings something new, from solving complex technical problems to collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive continuous improvement. What sets us apart? We value curiosity, ownership, and teamwork. You’ll work with and oversee a team of experienced engineers who are passionate about product quality and patient safety. If you enjoy digging into how things work, take pride in quality, and want your work to make a visible impact, you’ll feel right at home here. **Where you come in:** * Experienced technical leader familiar with industry best practices in test execution and system design. * Highly accountable manager that delivers results while defining challenging goals and objectives. * Manage multiple high\-priority requests from competing stakeholders and deploy resources to maximize business impact. * The ability to seamlessly lead and mentor the team in investigations of testing failures. * Lead continuous improvement initiatives to modernize, scale and optimize test processes and methodologies. **What makes you successful:** * A technical degree in engineering or related scientific field. Advanced degree preferred. * 3\+ years of leadership experience in medical device testing, design, development, and/or verification. * Knowledge in structured problem solving, test method validation, statistical analysis, and related technical skills. * A good understanding of emotional intelligence with strong interpersonal and communication skills. * A situational leader that flexes styles for the individual and task. * Knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 * Results\-oriented, self\-disciplined, fast\-paced, motivated individual that requires minimal supervision. **What you’ll get:** * A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . * A full and comprehensive benefits program. * Growth opportunities on a global scale. * Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. * An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** * 0\-5% **Experience and Education Requirements:** * **Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 8\-12 years of industry experience** * **Requires a degree in a technical discipline 2\-5 years of previous management or lead experience** Please note: The information contained herein is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Diodes Incorporated is seeking a **Design Engineering Manager to lead our AI\-Assisted Design Engineering** team. This role will lead and develop a growing team of engineers focused on applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation technologies to accelerate semiconductor design, verification, and product development. This role is ideal for an emerging engineering leader with who is passionate about mentoring others, driving innovation, and helping build next\-generation engineering capabilities. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ The successful candidate will blend technical expertise with strong leadership potential, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing team environment while guiding engineers through complex technical challenges. This position offers the opportunity to influence engineering strategy, champion AI\-enabled design methodologies, and play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor talent. **Who You Are** --------------- **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical Engineering \& Computer Science (EECS), or a related field. * 2 to 5\+ years of analog, mixed\-signal, or semiconductor design experience. * Demonstrated experience leading engineering projects, coordinating cross\-functional initiatives, mentoring junior engineers, or serving in a technical leadership capacity. * Proven ability to influence and guide others through collaboration, coaching, and technical expertise. * Strong understanding of: + Analog and mixed\-signal circuit design + Semiconductor device fundamentals **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong understanding of: + Circuit simulation, verification, and characterization + Engineering problem\-solving and debugging methodologies * Experience with Python or similar programming languages for automation, data analysis, or workflow optimization. * Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a dynamic engineering environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Provides coaching, mentorship, and constructive feedback to support employee growth and career development. * Effectively prioritizes work, delegates responsibilities, and aligns resources to achieve business objectives. * Encourages continuous improvement and embraces new technologies that enhance engineering productivity. * Exhibits strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical decisions with organizational goals. The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is **$150,000 to $180,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, education, location, and business needs. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package. This salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. **Life at Diodes** ------------------ Diodes Incorporated delivers advanced analog and power semiconductor solutions to the world’s leading technology companies, driving innovation, efficiency, and performance across high‑growth markets. Our teams collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, and corporate functions in a fast‑paced, transparent culture guided by **Integrity, Commitment, and Innovation**. We design reliable technology that improves the world—while prioritizing sustainability, safety, and employee well‑being. **Our Vision:** *Inspire future technology through leading semiconductor solutions.* *Diodes Incorporated is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.description: **Salesforce Software Engineer** **Chicago, IL \| Peoria, IL \| Dallas, TX (Hybrid)** *Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full\-time Salesforce Software Engineer to join our team in your choice of our Chicago, IL, Peoria, IL or Dallas, TX offices. We offer a hybrid work model with 1\-2 days per week of onsite work, full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company \- let's talk!* **Position Overview** We are seeking a Salesforce Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain Salesforce solutions that support enterprise digital platforms and customer, dealer, and partner\-facing experiences. This role blends hands\-on development across Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Flow with integration work, solution architecture, and cross\-functional collaboration in an Agile delivery environment. **Key Contributions \& Responsibilities** **Salesforce Application Development** * Design, develop, implement, test, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Agile/Scrum methodologies. * Develop Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, JavaScript, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. * Configure and customize Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, and related platform capabilities. * Implement declarative solutions using Flow, validation rules, custom objects, record\-triggered automation, approval processes, and platform configuration. * Develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST, SOAP, Platform Events, middleware, and event\-driven architecture patterns. * Participate in solution architecture design, code reviews, technical documentation, release planning, and platform optimization activities. **Technical Problem Solving** * Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce designs. * Troubleshoot Apex, LWC, automation, data, integration, deployment, and platform performance issues. * Optimize Salesforce security and access controls using profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, sharing rules, role hierarchy, and field\-level security. * Apply Salesforce development best practices, design patterns, and secure software engineering standards to build reliable enterprise solutions. **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement** * Collaborate with Product Owners, Salesforce Administrators, Salesforce Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, system analysts, and business stakeholders. * Gather, analyze, and refine functional and technical requirements for Salesforce initiatives and integrations. * Communicate platform capabilities, solution designs, project updates, and implementation approaches clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Participate in Agile sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, release readiness, and production\-support activities. **Testing \& Quality Assurance** * Develop and execute unit, integration, regression, and user\-acceptance testing for Salesforce solutions. * Maintain Apex test coverage and support mock testing for integrations and asynchronous processes. * Use Salesforce DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment quality and release reliability. * Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, platform governance, and coding standards. **Continuous Improvement** * Contribute to Salesforce development standards, reusable components, and coding guidelines. * Identify opportunities to improve business processes through Salesforce capabilities, integrations, automation, and data quality improvements. * Research and implement emerging Salesforce technologies, platform releases, and AI\-assisted development tools. * Support knowledge sharing, technical documentation, and mentoring of junior engineers when applicable. **Team Structure \& Work Environment** * Contribute to a range of technical solutions, including digital platforms, customer\-, dealer\-, and partner\-facing Salesforce experiences, Experience Cloud portals, internal business tools, workflow automation, and API\-led integrations. * Hybrid work model with 1\-2 office days per week; candidates should be prepared to transition to full\-time onsite work in the future. **Requirements** **Candidate Requirements** **Education \& Experience** * No degree required. * 2\-4 years of experience in Salesforce development, required. * Salesforce certification is a plus, but not required. **Required Technical Skills** * Hands\-on experience developing, configuring, testing, and deploying solutions on the Salesforce Platform. * Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, Salesforce data modeling, and Salesforce security concepts. * Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications, APIs, middleware, identity providers, and external systems. * Understanding of Salesforce governance, platform limits, release management, and scalable solution design. * Experience with DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery, and enterprise software development practices. * Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Experience Cloud, or related Salesforce certifications preferred. **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Vision Insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid Holidays Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com Salary expectations: 100,000\-120,000 per annual

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
jobs.description: **Location** The senior Full\-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full\-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. **Who We Are** DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud\-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state \- from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. **The Opportunity** AI is the fastest\-growing line on our customers' cloud bills \- and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer into our R\&D team to own this product end\-to\-end \- from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI\-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow \- not as an occasional autocomplete \- and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. **Responsibilities** * Owning features end\-to\-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome \- reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. * Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works \- token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives \- and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. * Working AI\-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work \- exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. * Full\-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious \- clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on. * API\-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard\-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi\-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end\-to\-end in production * Strong Go for backend services \- APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them * Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented * Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface * Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery * Product\-oriented thinking \- you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built * AI\-augmented working style \- you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short * Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others * Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-moving market \- you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution * Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal Self\-organized, goal\-oriented and self\-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious **Bonus Points** * Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus. * BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far **Are you a Do'er?** Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button. Full\-time employee benefits include: * Unlimited Vacation * Flexible Working Options * Health Insurance * Parental Leave * Employee Stock Option Plan * Home Office Allowance * Professional Development Stipend * Peer Recognition Program **Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT** unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal\-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41663 **About Us** Dolby Cloud Solutions is a video streaming software company that helps enterprise and mid\-market organizations deliver exceptional audio and video experiences to their audiences. The Dolby OptiView SaaS platform serves a growing portfolio of customers across media, advertising, and real\-time communications — with a mission to make immersive video experiences accessible and scalable for everyone. **About This Role** Dolby Cloud Solutions is embedding AI into the core of how it operates — not as a side project, but as a fundamental shift in how work gets done across the business. The philosophy guiding this work is simple: AI prepares, humans decide. This is a Staff\-level engineering role at the center of that effort. You will own the technical architecture of the shared AI infrastructure that DCS teams build their business processes on — and you will build specific solutions on top of it. You will define the patterns, standards, and integration approaches that others follow, and serve as the technical authority when architectural decisions need to be made. Business problems are owned by business stakeholders. You will work closely with those stakeholders — helping shape requirements and acceptance criteria where needed, then owning the build end to end. You will also collaborate with OptiView Product Engineering on shared infrastructure and systems integration, and engage Product Engineering when platform features or APIs need to be developed to support the work. **What You'll Do** **Own the AI systems architecture** * Define the technical architecture of the shared data and integration layer — not just build it, but set the standards and patterns that others build on top of * Establish integration patterns, credential management standards, and data access models that scale across teams and systems * Ensure the infrastructure is secure, observable, and operable — not just functional at launch **Build and integrate across systems** * Architect and implement the foundational data and integration layer that enables AI agents and applications to operate reliably across business functions * Build and maintain integrations between business systems — CRM, billing, support, product usage, and more — so that data flows where it needs to go * Collaborate with Product Engineering on shared infrastructure, systems integration, and platform capabilities — you know when to build and when to align * Configure and manage MCP servers and API connections to internal systems, with proper credential management and security controls * Stand up shared hosting infrastructure for agents, automations, and applications, moving work off local workstations and into production environments * Build scheduled automations and event\-driven workflows that run reliably without manual intervention **Deliver business solutions** * Work with business stakeholders to understand problems, refine requirements, and define acceptance criteria — then own the build * Develop customer\-facing and internal applications from requirements and user stories — these may be web applications, headless services, agentic flows, or a combination * Build AI\-powered workflows for business teams including customer health monitoring, automated alerts, meeting intelligence, and revenue lifecycle automation * Iterate rapidly: deploy working software, collect feedback, and improve **Raise the technical floor across DCS** * Set the technical bar for how AI systems are built, integrated, and maintained across the organization — your decisions become the standard others follow * Maintain a shared repository of prompts, agents, skills, and workflows organized for reuse across teams * Help colleagues across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Finance build and deploy their own AI solutions on the shared infrastructure **What You Bring** **Required** * 5\+ years building production software — applications, APIs, backend services, platform infrastructure, or data integrations — with a demonstrated track record of leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (Devin, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of engineering delivery * Proven experience making architectural decisions, set technical standards, and influenced how an engineering organization builds * Strong with Python or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable picking up whatever the job requires * Experience building tool\-use integrations for AI systems; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar protocols/frameworks is strongly preferred * Proven experience integrating with SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth) — you have connected real business systems and understand the edge cases * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks — you have built production agents or AI\-powered workflows, not just prototypes * Comfortable working with business stakeholders — you can participate in requirements discussions, ask the right questions, push back constructively, and translate business intent into working software * Experienced collaborating with product and platform engineering teams — you know how to articulate what you need, align on approach, and get things built across team boundaries * Security\-conscious: you understand data classification, access controls, API credentials, compliance requirements, and risk management principles, and you incorporate them into the systems you build **Strong Plus** * Experience designing federated data layers, shared integration infrastructure, or multi\-system data pipelines * Familiarity with common SaaS business systems used in revenue, support, or customer success operations * Background in Customer Success, RevOps, or SaaS B2B — you understand the business domain you're building for * Experience incorporating data classification, compliance, security, and risk assessment considerations into the design and operation of AI\-powered systems and business automations

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **About Doximity** Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity's AI\-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300\+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. jobs.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life\-threatening diseases. In this role, you will gain exposure to applied machine learning workflows, including model development, evaluation, interpretability research, and data pipeline optimization. This role will be responsible for building out standardized, general\-purpose interpretability tooling that contributes to research\-driven software solutions supporting scientific discovery. This is a contract role, expected to last approximately 3 months, with an anticipated workload of 20 hours per week. **About You** You are passionate about machine learning, computer vision, and solving complex data\-driven challenges. You enjoy designing experiments, analyzing results, and building models that generate meaningful insights. You are analytical, curious, and comfortable working with image data, machine learning frameworks, and real\-world datasets. You enjoy collaborating with engineers and scientists and are motivated to translate research ideas into practical tools and prototype solutions. **What You'll Do** * Lead or substantially contribute to a research\-focused project related to model interpretability and machine learning. * Develop and evaluate machine learning approaches to improve model performance, robustness, and usability of internal tools. * Support development and testing of model interpretability techniques to better understand and evaluate machine learning systems. * Design and execute targeted experiments to evaluate model performance, training strategies, and data pipeline improvements. * Prepare, clean, and analyze image\-based and structured datasets to support machine learning model development. * Evaluate model outputs using quantitative performance metrics and visualization techniques. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate research concepts into prototype solutions and internal tools. * Document technical approaches, experimental results, and research findings. * Present project outcomes and key learnings. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or graduate\-level degree (completed or in progress) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. * Coursework or hands\-on experience in machine learning, statistics, and computer vision. * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience with data analysis, experimental design, and machine learning model evaluation. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret and communicate technical findings. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while managing independent research or development tasks. * Must be available to work part\-time (20 hours per week) during core business hours for the duration of the 3\-month contract term. * Exposure to model interpretability, explainability, or visualization techniques is preferred. The expected hourly rate for this role is $56 to $68 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment. We are currently not accepting any new third\-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Department: IT \| Level: Lead Role Summary: The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the enterprise data platform that powers analytics, reporting, and business applications across El Car Wash. This role develops scalable data pipelines, integrates data from multiple business systems, and transforms raw data into trusted, business\-ready datasets that support Finance, Operations, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Technology. As a key member of the Technology team, the Data Engineer will build and optimize our Snowflake data platform using a modern medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), ensuring data is reliable, secure, well\-governed, and accessible. This role will partner closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to support business intelligence, automation, and future AI initiatives while helping standardize data across acquisitions and multiple source systems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines within the Snowflake data platform using a Bronze, Silver, and Gold (medallion) architecture. * Develop and optimize data models using dbt Cloud to create reliable, business\-ready datasets. * Integrate and manage data from multiple enterprise systems including POS, HRIS, ERP, CRM, Finance, Marketing, and operational platforms. * Lead the migration of legacy SQL Server and Azure SQL data environments into a modern cloud\-based architecture. * Develop and maintain a unified enterprise data model that standardizes information across multiple source systems and acquisitions. * Build automated ingestion, transformation, and change\-detection processes to support new business applications and acquisitions. * Implement data quality standards, testing, documentation, monitoring, and governance best practices. * Establish CI/CD processes and version control to support reliable, scalable data development. * Partner with Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Technology teams to understand business requirements and deliver trusted reporting and analytics solutions. * Support business intelligence, dashboards, self\-service reporting, and future AI and automation initiatives. * Troubleshoot data issues, optimize platform performance, and continuously improve the reliability and scalability of the data ecosystem. QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or analytics engineering. * Strong experience with Snowflake, including warehouse management, security, and performance optimization. * Experience with dbt and dbt Cloud for data modeling, testing, documentation, and deployment. * Advanced SQL skills with experience optimizing and modernizing legacy SQL environments. * Experience designing dimensional data models, including Kimball methodologies and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 2\). * Experience building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and modern orchestration tools. * Familiarity with Azure cloud services including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and related services. * Experience with Git\-based version control and CI/CD processes. * Experience integrating multiple enterprise applications and APIs. * Knowledge of business intelligence platforms such as Power BI or similar visualization tools. * Experience supporting retail, hospitality, automotive, or multi\-location businesses is preferred. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and effectively manage multiple priorities.

alike. * Ability to build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading architectural transformation and modernization initiatives for large, distributed systems. * Expertise in full stack engineering with a frontend leaning, and a proven ability to operate across multiple technical domains and platforms. * A track record of jobs.title: Head of Deployment (Customer Success)
jobs.description: **About Flow** -------------- Flow is the systems engineering platform for the world's best hardware teams. Companies like Rivian run their programs on Flow, keeping requirements, interfaces, tests, and design decisions connected in one live system instead of scattered across documents and legacy tools. We're growing fast, backed by Sequoia, and selling into an industry that is actively rethinking how engineering work gets done. **The role** ------------ Flow is a system of record, and a system of record only delivers value when an engineering org actually lives in it. A requirements platform that half the team uses isn't half as valuable, it's worse than nothing, because now there are two sources of truth. So our post\-sale work isn't check\-in calls and QBRs. It's deployment: migrating requirements out of legacy tools and spreadsheets, configuring Flow around how each customer's programs actually run, redesigning workflows, and driving the organizational change that gets hundreds of engineers to move their daily work into a new system. You'll inherit over a hundred customers across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise, a small team of reps who manage the renewal book today, the post\-sale side of our forward\-deployed team, a support motion that needs to be scaled, and a team plan that goes to 10\+ people in 12 months. You'll start as a true player\-coach: carrying your own book of accounts, running their deployments end to end, and owning their renewals personally. The methodology should come from the work and first principles, not another playbook from a different company. As the team scales, you'll shift weight toward leading, but the expectation is that you never fully leave the field. **What you'll own in year one** ------------------------------- * Carry your own book of accounts: lead their deployments, drive their adoption, and personally own their renewals * Define the deployment methodology: what "deployed" means, the phased rollout playbook, adoption measurement, and health scoring built on real usage rather than logins * Design the coverage model: embedded deployments for enterprise, guided rollouts for mid\-market, scaled low\-touch for SMB * Own renewals end to end, leading the reps who run the book today and building the motion around them, with expansion signals passed to the AE team * Stand up support: tiering, response expectations, and a clean escalation path into engineering * Assess, develop, and grow the team you inherit, then hire and ramp to 10\+, and shape the split of the current forward\-deployed team with our incoming Head of Solutions Engineering Compensation Range: $195K \- $265K

jobs.title: Solutions Architect – Data Analytics (Remote)
jobs.description: **Job Posting:** Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best\-in\-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. **Solutions Architect – Data Analytics** ---------------------------------------- We are looking for an experienced and driven **Solutions Architect** responsible for defining and guiding the technical implementation of the organization's enterprise data strategy centered on the **Databricks Lakehouse Platform**. In this role, you will design scalable, secure, and high\-performing data solutions that enable analytics, AI, machine learning, and operational reporting. You will serve as a key technical leader, bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution across a hybrid enterprise landscape. Location: This role is approved to be fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States. **Duties and Responsibilities:** -------------------------------- * Delivers the development of strategic direction and leadership in the development of enterprise\-wide solution architecture. * Executes design, improvements, and/or execution of architecture from design through completion of products and/or features (e.g., drives solutions performance, quality, etc.). * Guides the definition of solution/system architecture and design across multiple products or systems. * Ensures the translation of requirements into effective solution architecture and design across products or systems. * Participates in cross\-architecture reviews across solution sets and ensures upstream and downstream integration requirements. * Create and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards for all architecture solutions and frameworks. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers building and consuming architecture solutions. * Conduct architecture reviews and ensure automation designs meet security, compliance, and performance requirements. * Collaborate with multi\-functional business customers to translate business requirements into automated, scalable technical solutions. * Monitor environment health, identify failure patterns, and drive continuous improvement across the data ecosystem. * Stay ahead of emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends to recommend and implement innovative solutions. **Qualifications and Requirements:** ------------------------------------ * 4\+ years of experience in enterprise IT operations, systems engineering, or infrastructure architecture, including experience designing enterprise\-scale solutions spanning multiple applications, data sources, and technology platforms. * Deep expertise in Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation, puppet, chef for provisioning and configuration management. * Proven background in crafting and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. * Strong experience designing cloud\-based data solutions, preferably within Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage/ADLS, Azure networking, identity and access management, Key Vault, and related services. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing an enterprise data platform using Databricks or a comparable modern cloud data platform. * Experience designing data architectures that support enterprise BI and analytics, preferably including Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. * Solid understanding of on\-premises infrastructure including Windows and Linux operating systems, networking (routing, load balancers, VPNs), and security infrastructure (firewalls, IDS/IPS). * Knowledge of DevOps and agile methodologies with a track record of successfully contributing into software delivery lifecycles. * Experience with identity and access management automation, including AD integration and role\-based access control provisioning. * Proficiency in cost management and optimization strategies for cloud\-based capacity workloads. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or similar is a plus. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess complex environments and deliver actionable automation strategies, with a strong emphasis on execution. * Good communication and collaboration skills, capable of influencing technical and non\-technical collaborators and mentoring junior engineers. * Innovative mentality with a willingness to challenge legacy processes and champion modern automation approaches. * High adaptability and a continuous learning mentality to keep pace with the constantly evolving automation and cloud landscape. **Why Join Us** --------------- You'll play a central role in transforming how our enterprise operates — defining and delivering the framework for a best\-in\-class analytics ecosystem. You'll work across a broad technology stack in a collaborative environment that values governance, innovation, and operational excellence, with real opportunities to shape the analytics strategy of a large, complex organization. At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well\-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well\-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more! \#LI\-REMOTE * **Pay Range:** * *Actual pay rate may vary depending upon location. The estimated pay range for this position is below. The specific rate will depend on a candidate’s qualifications and prior experience.* * $5,444\.76 \- $9,537\.00* ***Estimated Ranges displayed are Monthly for Salaried roles*** **OR** ***Hourly for all other roles.*** * This role is Bonus or Incentive Plan eligible. * Ferguson complies with all wage regulations. The starting wage may be higher in certain locations based on local or state wage requirements. * *The Company is an equal opportunity employer as well as a government contractor that shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60\-300\.5(a), which prohibits discrimination against qualified protected Veterans and the requirements of 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(A), which prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals on the basis of disability.* *Ferguson Enterprises, LLC. is an equal employment employer* *F/M/Disability/Vet/Sexual* *Orientation/Gender* *Identity.* Equal Employment Opportunity and Reasonable Accommodation Information

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Ferguson Electric’s Electrical Engineer II is a mid\-level position for engineers focusing on becoming self\-sufficient on design and engineering tasks. This position will contribute to the electrical system design, engineering, commissioning and construction efforts for commercial and industrial projects, including healthcare, education, research, commercial facilities, and utilities. This role involves supporting project design teams, developing innovative electrical solutions, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards. The Electrical Engineer II role will provide guidance to junior staff as needed, assist in managing project deliverables, and support the company’s commitment to quality, safety, and client satisfaction while upholding Ferguson Electric’s core values. RESPONSIBILITIES * **Electrical Systems Design**: + Design of electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, and communication systems, for commercial and industrial projects. + Support the development of project design goals, specifications, and strategies to meet client requirements and project objectives. + Participate in quality control reviews of engineering documents to learn about accuracy and compliance with project requirements. + Help ensure designs comply with applicable codes (e.g., NFPA, IEEE) and industry standards. * **Electrical Systems Analysis and Field Support**: + Help specify electrical equipment, components, and materials, ensuring compatibility with project needs and budgets under supervision. + Perform engineering studies, such as load analysis, short\-circuit, and coordination and arc flash, using tools like SKM or Easypower with minimal supervision. + Review of submittals, shop drawings, and other construction documents to ensure they are meeting the project requirements. + Develop relay, transformer, breaker and battery testing plans and reports with minimal experience. + Develop relay programs with minimal guidance. + Support service technicians with troubleshooting customer electrical system problems under the guidance of higher\-level engineers. * **Project Leadership**: + Support the coordination of electrical engineering aspects of projects, helping adhere to budgets, schedules, and quality standards. + Participate in project team and client meetings to align on project scope, progress, and deliverables. + Assist in the preparation of construction documents, including drawings and specifications. * **Site Engagement**: + Participate in job site visits to observe existing conditions, monitor construction progress, and learn about compliance with design specifications. + Attend construction meetings and provide basic technical support to field teams and subcontractors as needed. + Perform physical walk\-throughs of sites under supervision to assess conditions and resolve issues. * **Process Improvement**: + Contribute to strategies to improve design quality, coordination, and efficiency in production efforts. + Support the incorporation of renewable and sustainable design practices where applicable to enhance project outcomes. Requirements: ABOUT YOUR QUALIFICATIONS * **Education and Experience**: + Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program required and preferred with electrical systems focus. + 4\-6 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on commercial or industrial projects. + Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification is required or additional 5 years of experience directly related to the job responsibilities. * **Technical Skills**: + Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for documentation and reporting. + Proficiency in drawing software (e.g. Revit and AutoCAD) and electrical analysis software (e.g., SKM) is preferred. + Good understanding of designing power distribution, lighting, and communication systems per NEC, IEEE and other relevant codes is preferred. + Ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications. + Basic understanding and knowledge of electrical system installation methods and standards. + Exposure to renewable energy systems or sustainable design practices is a plus. * **Soft Skills**: + Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work on multiple tasks. + Good leadership and mentorship skills to contribute to team efforts. + Good communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with clients, contractors, and internal teams. + Organizational and time management skills to handle tasks and meet deadlines. + Ability to adapt to an adjusted work schedule, including occasional overtime or evening/weekend hours, to meet project demands. + Willingness to accept constructive feedback and make changes as necessary to improve job performance. + Willingness to learn and develop skills in various engineering tasks, software, and equipment. * **Other Requirements**: + Ability to conduct physical site walk\-throughs and work in various environmental conditions. + Participate in in\-house and manufacturer training to enhance skills.

jobs.title: Junior Estimator - OSP/Telecom
jobs.description: About Us: A fully owned subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR), FiberTel, LLC. is locally grown in Utah’s Art City and has rapidly expanded over the Northwest and Western regions. As an advocate for economic growth in the state of Utah, Idaho, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, and California we understand the business of conveying information. With all that is happening in our state and nationwide, we are seeing different ways of life, work, and school. The increase in work from home and online school has put a strain on internet providers and their bandwidth. Internet Providers are relying heavily on us to continue the construction and installation of fiber optics to ensure that internet service goes uninterrupted for the people of our communities. We are a utility construction company, with a specialization in the installation of fiber optics. We offer a full turnkey experience for our clients. For our employees, we offer rewarding benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid vacation, paid holidays, and 401k (with company match). We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and participate in E\-Verify. About this Role: FiberTel is looking for a **Junior Estimator** for our Sacramento, CA location. The Junior Estimator will work closely with senior estimators, project managers, and operations teams to assist with preparing cost estimates and bid proposals for Outside Plant (OSP) fiber optic construction projects. *Pay: $28\-40/hr, DOE* What You'll Do: * Assist in the preparation of cost estimates for OSP fiber optic construction projects. * Review and analyze construction drawings, specifications, permits, and project documents. * Perform quantity takeoffs and track labor, equipment, and material costs. * Support the development of bid packages, proposals, and subcontractor/vendor solicitations. * Obtain pricing from suppliers, subcontractors, and vendors. * Assist with maintaining estimating databases and unit cost information. * Attend pre\-bid meetings, site walks, and project review meetings as needed. * Collaborate with estimators, project managers, engineers, and field personnel to develop accurate project estimates. * Help prepare change order pricing and budget updates for ongoing projects. * Maintain organized project files and bid documentation. * Learn applicable telecom construction methods, industry standards, and FiberTel estimating procedures. * Perform other duties as assigned by management. What You'll Bring: * High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. * 0\-3 years of experience in estimating, construction, telecom, utilities, or a related industry. * Basic understanding of construction plans, specifications, and contract documents is preferred. * Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. * Strong mathematical, analytical, and organizational skills. * Ability to learn estimating software and construction management systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. * Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn and grow professionally. * Experience with telecom, utility, or fiber optic construction is a plus. What You'll Get: **Working Conditions:** This is a full\-time hourly position, expected to work at least 40 hours per week. This position typically operates in an office environment with occasional time out in the field for site walks and similar tasks. This position my be exposed to different types of weather, loud noises and other construction hazards associated with the field. **Benefits Include:*** Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident * Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts * PWR Discounts (Flight Tickets, Amusement Park Tickets, Nike) * Group Discount (Pet Insurance, Auto Insurance, Home Insurance) * Retirement Savings Plan (401K) with company matching * Short \& Long Term Disability * Supplemental Life and AD\&D Insurance * Paid Holidays and Vacation * **Pay is based on the knowledge, skills, and abilities of the employee.** Applicants are required to pass all company drug testing, submit to a background check and adhere to all OSHA, state, city/municipality safety requirements and training provided by the company as required* Our Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind including, based on disability and protected veteran status. The Company's policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also the Company's policy to comply with all applicable state and federal laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. Please visit the following URL to view the EEO is the Law poster and the Supplement. (https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/ofccpost.htm) The Company also does not consider criminal convictions to be an absolute bar to employment and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories. Applicants applying for positions in Illinois are not required to disclose arrests or sealed or expunged records of convictions. FiberTel, LLC Compensation Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $28\.00/Hr. \- USD $40\.00/Hr. depending on experience and qualifications. Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. jobs.title: Software Development Manager
jobs.description: SoftPro is the nation's leading provider of real estate closing and title insurance software. A division of Fidelity National Financial (NYSE: FNF), SoftPro’s technology solutions are used in thousands of law firms and title companies throughout the country and are an essential part of residential and commercial Real Estate transactions. SoftPro’s Headquarters is in Raleigh, North Carolina. SoftPro has received national recognition for our excellent customer service and products and we were recently recognized as a 2026 Best Places to Work by the Triangle Business Journal! SoftPro has won this prestigious award 14 times since 2012! **Why Join SoftPro?** We believe in taking care of our people and fostering a culture of excellence. Here’s what we offer: * **Comprehensive Benefits** : Medical, dental, vision, disability, and more * **Financial Wellness** : 401(k) with company match and Employee Stock Purchase Plan * **Generous Paid Time Off** : vacation, holidays, and parental leave * **Flexibility** : Some positions are eligible for 100% remote work, plus hybrid options for those living near our Raleigh HQ **Award\-Winning Culture** SoftPro has received national recognition for our outstanding customer service and innovative products. We were recently named a **2026 Best Place to Work by the Triangle Business Journal** —an honor we’ve earned **14 times since 2012!** If these values resonate with you, we’d love to have you on our team! **What are we looking for?** SoftPro is looking for a **Software Development Manager** to lead their awesome teams for a new SaaS product initiative. This position is located in our Raleigh, NC office. This is a hybrid position, with a requirement to be in the office 2\-3 days a week. The primary responsibility of the Development Manager is to build and maintain high\-performing software development teams including hiring, facilitating training and onboarding. They will collaborate closely with the Product Owners and Scrum Masters to ensure the teams are meeting their commitments. This position will report to the Director of Software Engineering. **What will I do as the Software Development Manager on the SaaS Team at SoftPro?** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Champion and continuously improve a modern, Azure\-centric SDLC with a focus on agile delivery, DevOps automation and CI/CD. * Enforce high engineering standards through code reviews with a relentless focus on technical excellence and secure\-by\-default design. * Drive the adoption of Azure\-native tools for observability, resilience, and deployment (e.g., Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, AKS). * Participate in the implementation of Generative AI Assisted / Agentic Coding approaches in our Software Development Lifecycle. * Lead teams that are a mix of on\- and nearshore (LATAM/Eastern Europe) resources. * Own the team’s delivery process—from work intake and planning to quality assurance and deployment—ensuring transparency, accountability, and predictable outcomes. * Eliminate friction in developer workflows by streamlining tooling, reducing unnecessary meetings, and fostering deep focus time. * Encourage experimentation, continuous refactoring, and automation to reduce toil and increase velocity. * Make timely decisions, communicate proactively, and adjust quickly to changing priorities without compromising quality or morale. * Lead the team through tight timelines while maintaining a sustainable pace and a can\-do attitude. * Collaborate seamlessly with other Development Managers, Product Managers and Architects to deliver a solution that not only works, but delights **What skills do I need to be successful as a Software Development Manager on the SaaS Team at SoftPro?** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * 7\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, including deep knowledge of the Microsoft stack: .NET, C\#, SQL Server, and cloud\-native Azure services, as well as modern front\-end frameworks, such as angular. * 5\+ years of experience managing jobs.title: RC Aviation Instructor
jobs.description: RC Aviation Instructor — Build and Fly, Part\-Time (Jersey City) **Company:** Flight \& Aerospace Academy **Location:** 118 Ferry Street, Jersey City, NJ 07307 (on\-site) **Job type:** Part\-time, hourly, school year **Pay:** $40 to $60 per hour **Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 3:45 PM to 7:00 PM · Saturday, 10:30 AM to 12:00 PM. Additional weekday slots available as we grow. **Get paid to do the thing you already do in your garage** If you build RC planes, cars, or boats for fun, this is a job where that hobby is the entire curriculum. Flight \& Aerospace Academy is a fast\-growing aviation and engineering academy in Jersey City. Our students learn to fly on a Cessna simulator, build drones from CAD to first flight, and engineer robotic arms from scratch. We are hiring an instructor to run our RC track, where students go from a blank sketch to an airplane they designed, built, and flew themselves. Classes are small, hands\-on, and run after school and Saturday mornings during the school year. **What you'll teach** Our RC course takes students from sketch to first flight. Over a semester, they: * Learn the aerodynamics behind why a wing works, and what happens when you change it * Design an airframe and make real engineering tradeoffs on weight, wing loading, and control surface sizing * Cut, build, and finish the airframe using foam, balsa, carbon, and 3D\-printed parts * Wire the electronics: motor, ESC, servos, receiver, battery, and how to not let the magic smoke out * Set up, trim, and range\-check the aircraft before it ever leaves the bench * Fly it, crash it, diagnose what failed, and fix it The last part is the point. A student who repairs their own wing after a hard landing has learned more than one who never crashed. **What you'll actually do** * Run 90\-minute classes with small groups (1:5 max instructor\-to\-student ratio) for students ages 8 and up * Prep builds, kits, and bench stations so class time is spent building, not unpacking * Teach shop safety and enforce it: soldering irons, hobby knives, LiPo handling, prop safety * Help students debug their own builds instead of fixing it for them * Shape where the track goes next. RC Aerial Combat is on our 2027 roadmap and we want the person who builds it **What we're looking for** **Required** * Real hands\-on RC experience. You have built and flown your own aircraft or vehicles, not just bought ready\-to\-fly * Comfortable with soldering, basic electronics, and LiPo battery safety * Good with kids and teens. Patient, calm around mistakes, and able to explain a concept three different ways * Available Thursday, Friday, and Saturday during the school year * Able to get to Jersey City reliably **Nice to have** * CAD experience (Fusion 360, Onshape, or similar) and 3D printing * AMA membership or club flying experience * Background in aerospace or mechanical engineering, or a student currently studying it * Part 107, drone building, or FPV experience * Teaching, coaching, camp, or tutoring experience You do not need a teaching certificate. You need to know how to build things and how to get a twelve\-year\-old to want to build them too. **Why this role is worth your time** * **A real workshop.** 3D printers, CAD software, bench tools, and a materials budget. You are not teaching this off a worksheet * **Ownership.** We are early and growing fast. The person in this role writes the curriculum, picks the platforms, and decides what students build * **Predictable part\-time hours** that fit around classes, another job, or your own projects * **Students who stay.** Our RC track connects into flight training, drones, and engineering, so you keep working with the same kids as they progress **How to apply** Apply through Indeed with your resume. We review applications as they come in and move quickly. Flight \& Aerospace Academy is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $40\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 – 20\.0 per week Work Location: In person

Review for correctness, test quality, and architectural fit. * **Testing:** Design test approaches for complex features, write end\-to\-end tests for critical paths, and evaluate test quality during code review. * **Debugging and troubleshooting:** Diagnose and fix multithreaded and concurrency issues. Handle complex issues, including on\-call rotation for critical customer issues (off\-hours support required, though not the norm). * **Database:** Optimize queries using indexes and constraints. Understand ORM tradeoffs and have basic NoSQL familiarity. * **Security:** Apply least\-privilege principles and understand timing attacks and encryption basics (PKI vs. symmetric). * **AI\-augmented development:** Use LLMs as part of the SDLC, including code review assistance, documentation drafting, and refactoring. Help the team rethink how work gets done with AI in the loop. * **Technical roadmap:** Identify areas of tech debt and propose focus areas for the team. * **Cross\-functional communication:** Present designs and tradeoffs to Product, DevSuccess, and Support.
